- **Age:** fourteen  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face paired with a snubbed nose. She is also characterized by a wide mouth and wide smiles.

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows genuine concern for the well-being of her adored mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

- warm-hearted  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

## History

Charlotta, whose birth name was Leonora, served as a maid to Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She frequently entertained visiting guests like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and she shared her worries with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Miss Lavendar experienced melancholic moods. Charlotta later witnessed the joyful reunion and subsequent wedding of Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), during which she helped prepare for the events and later kept in contact with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> “Oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am,” she breathed, “I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> “No, I can understand that,” said Charlotta. “A wedding ain’t poetry. Why, Miss Shirley, ma’am, you’re crying! What for?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta is a wholehearted admirer and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), having first met her when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta enjoys spending time with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), often chatting in the garden, hosting tea, and sharing her concerns with her. While picking berries together, Charlotta confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which prompts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan extended visits to help cheer the household up.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +8 more_

- Friend of — wholehearted admirer and friend  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta is a friend to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), having warmly welcomed her and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when the pair accidentally discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She helps entertain [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) alongside her mistress during their visits to the lodge for tea. Later, Charlotta visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is helping prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding, during the same period [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) announces her engagement.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +14 more_

- Friend of — welcomes her warmly at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the handmaiden to Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she is part of a succession of maids called Charlotta. She cares deeply for her employer's well-being, worrying about Miss Lavendar's melancholic moods and confiding her concerns to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Charlotta assists Miss Lavendar during visits from guests, helps prepare for Stephen Irving's arrival, and happily observes their eventual reconciliation and wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +23 more_

- Serves under — employer/master to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta maintains a close friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), acting as her chum during Anne's frequent visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). They spend time together chatting in the garden, picking berries, and observing the romantic reconciliation of Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Charlotta also pays visits to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while helping with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +24 more_

- Friend of — chums  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
